method_selection.why: The parent learning curve is unavailable, so overfit or underfit cannot be inferred. The accepted tuned package improved only from 0.6018 to 0.6034, indicating that the current representation is nearing a flat-signal regime. This full, literature-grounded composite is independently measured at 0.6055-0.6061 and combines causal author history, session context, censored watch-time auxiliary supervision, and a predeclared 2-3 seed mean-logit close. Its honest expected gain over the 0.6034 parent is roughly +0.0021 to +0.0027, enough to plausibly clear the 0.002 convergence threshold, and 14 remaining iterations provide room to reproduce the complex package faithfully and still preserve later closing budget.

rejected.reason: Cheap and measured strong on a weaker 0.6018-family parent, but its incremental gain when stacked onto the existing BCE/BPR package is unknown and may be below the convergence threshold.
Mechanistically suitable for the temporal split, but its measured +0.0015 gain is below the current 0.002 convergence epsilon.

method_selection.citation: gauge-fixing rationale (per-user constant shifts leave the metric invariant); pairwise-consistency literature.
method_selection.why: The parent improved only +0.0008, below the 0.002 convergence threshold, and no usable learning curve supports an overfit or underfit diagnosis. The remaining actionable issue is objective/evaluator disagreement: ordinary BCE spends capacity on per-user logit offsets that GAUC/nDCG ignore. User-centered BCE is a cheap, atomic change compatible with the current pointwise head and has a measured +0.0026 result on Pure, making it the strongest eligible option with 13 iterations left.

rejected.reason: Although metric-aligned and untried in this exact form, closely related delta-nDCG pair weighting repeatedly failed, so its expected gain is less credible than the measured gauge-fixed BCE gain.
It is lower-confidence and likely mis-targeted because validation slates contain only about five impressions, leaving little distinct top-tail structure.
Its higher-capacity, long-training package intersects the excluded underfit family and poses substantial memorization and runtime risk on Pure.

expected_delta_basis: The gauge-fixed-bce method card reports a measured +0.0026 primary gain over the 0.6018-family parent in run_novel_r1 node_003.
